polaris: LP29-C2T-S2 / context baseline vs reproduced Srivastava exact O_s baseline

framework.name: failure-mode schema for proof-carrying O_s reproduction
framework.discipline_source: computer science: negative test oracles, proof-carrying execution, and supply-chain attestation
framework.round2_shift: Round 1 defined the certificate idea; Round 2 materializes the executor-facing failure modes that prevent reported context from being promoted to reproduced exact O_s.
framework.scope_limit: This is a payload admissibility result under C2T gates. It is not material validation and not a claim that Srivastava exact O_s is impossible to reproduce in principle.

math_object.object_name: Srivastava exact O_s reproduction failure-mode lattice
math_object.definition: A finite set of typed blockers over witness fields whose join determines whether a row claiming srivastava_reproduction is executable, context-only, or blocked.

gate_projection.G5: Formula/code, normalization, and same-structure mapping decide whether Srivastava-style OI reproduction is admissible.
gate_projection.G6: The executor recomputes row_decision from payload fields and ignores manual labels.
gate_projection.G7: Material validation remains false unless row_decision is PASS and unresolved blockers are cleared.

math_object.minimal_replay_equation: O_s = N(S, P, theta_norm)[ sum_{(i,j) in P(S, theta_pair)} omega(i,j; theta_formula) ]
math_object.failure_invariant: Any missing identity, pair-rule, raw-sum, normalization, same-structure, or executor-trace witness changes the payload from reproduced exact O_s into context-only or BLOCK.

findings.finding: The current payload does not reproduce Srivastava exact O_s because it lacks executor-grade witnesses for at least formula/code, normalization, same-structure mapping, raw overlap sum, pair selection, and replay trace.
The smallest useful Round 2 artifact is a failure-mode table, not another prose certificate: it makes every blocked jump explicit and machine-auditable.
Reported Srivastava context remains allowed as literature context, but it must not be used as a graph-vs-overlap residual baseline until a replayable O_s payload passes.

strangest_prediction.prediction: The first successful exact O_s reproduction payload will look like a failed build log that has been repaired one blocker at a time: formula/code, raw sum, pair rule, normalization, same-structure identity, and executor trace will collapse into one replay chain.
strangest_prediction.observable: Adding prose context or a reported OI_norm alone will not change G5 from BLOCK to PASS. Only machine-reviewable witnesses that bind the same source row and structure to the replayed raw sum and normalization should change the executor status.
strangest_prediction.falsifier: If an executor can emit PASS for srivastava_reproduction while exact_overlap_formula_or_code_ref, normalization_rule_ref, or same_structure_mapping_ref is missing, then C2T_gate_predicates.csv and the payload schema are inconsistent.

a_objection.likely_objection: A conservative route may say that reported OI_norm is enough for a contextual comparison and that a failure-mode schema overburdens the literature claim.
a_objection.b_reply: That is correct only for reported_context_only. The moment the row is used as an exact residual-validation baseline, the claim becomes executable reproduction, and the proof-carrying witnesses are the minimal anti-leakage contract.

failed_jumps.attempt: Use a paper-level citation as source identity.
failed_jumps.why_failed: Paper-level identity cannot select one row, structure, snapshot, or denominator; it therefore blocks deterministic replay.
A checksum is only useful when source, build rule, dependencies, and intermediate hashes are known. A reported normalized value lacks that chain.

failed_jumps.attempt: Let same material or composition stand in for same structure.
failed_jumps.why_failed: Exact O_s is atomistic-structure and pair-rule dependent; material-name identity is insufficient under G1/G5.

failed_jumps.attempt: Convert a blocked reproduction payload into a physical disagreement.
failed_jumps.why_failed: The blocker is epistemic and executor-level. It does not say Srivastava O_s is wrong or unreproducible in principle.

next_plan.immediate: Use the CSV failure-mode schema as the negative-control table for any Srivastava-style row claiming exact O_s reproduction.
next_plan.executor_rule: Emit BLOCK for srivastava_reproduction when any required G5 witness is missing; preserve reported_context_only as a non-reproduction status.
next_plan.next_round_request: If Round 3 continues, build a null witness payload instance that conforms to C2T_witness_payload_schema.json and deterministically maps these failure modes to G5/G6/G7 decisions.

claims.statement: Under the current C2T witness schema and gate predicates, a row claiming Srivastava exact O_s reproduction must be blocked unless exact formula/code, normalization, and same-structure mapping are present as machine-reviewable witnesses.
equations: G5 = PASS iff applies_to_row=false OR (exact_overlap_formula_or_code_ref != null AND normalization_rule_ref != null AND same_structure_mapping_ref != null AND witnesses machine_reviewable)
assumptions: The row is claiming srivastava_reproduction rather than reported_context_only.
Executor decisions are derived from payload fields, not manual labels.

claims.statement: Raw overlap sum, pair-selection rule, denominator trace, and executor trace are not extra material-validation claims; they are sub-witnesses needed to make exact O_s replay meaningful.
equations: O_s = N(S, P, theta_norm)[ sum_{(i,j) in P(S, theta_pair)} omega(i,j; theta_formula) ]
assumptions: Exact reproduction requires an auditable numerator, denominator or normalization, and identity binding.
Schema conformance is not material validation.

claims.statement: The correct Round 2 conclusion is: current payload not reproduced; this is not evidence that Srivastava exact O_s is unreproducible in principle.
assumptions: Future public or reconstructed witnesses may supply missing formula/code, normalization, same-structure mapping, and replay trace.
